Your wait is over. BEING, the sequel of HUMAN is now out in the world for you to continue your immersion into this mysterious story. BEING is a step in the world of HUMAN series.
Queen still keeps everyone moving, fed, and blissfully entertained. As you remember from Human, this future world is all about experiences.
It is a regime of mirrors: mindscopes.
We have a lady who refuses to be the way she’s designed. We have the talking white cat with star-bright eyes.
Our team of humans and beings against this reality of the future world.
BEING is waiting for its readers. Come inside.

body:
I'm Tomi Kauppinen, author of HUMAN series. From childhood, my passions spanned reading, arts, music, science, and travel, fueling diverse studies from computer science and philosophy to film theory and mathematics. My first real career was five+ years in data visualization and online business bolstered by eclectic experiences, like working in Paris to learn French and travelling to see the world.
Amidst industry work, I gravitated toward writing and research, pursuing a PhD in intelligent systems. My academic journey has been spanning cognitive systems, AI, visual communication, art, societal issues, spatial information, and online learning. I have been to 30+ countries via speeches, projects and collaborations. My passion drives me to this amazing combination of exploration, research, design, and education for storytelling, AR, and human interactions. I have a super creative and open attitude, yet also critical eye on AI's impact.
Host of the Cloud Reachers podcast, and author of HUMAN and co-editor of 'Design Education Across Disciplines,' my hobbies merge cyber-physical pursuits with literature, photography, physical exercises & sports and film. Through my books, workshops, projects, teaching, lab, and keynotes, I aspire to open doors for experiencing engaging adventures, fostering invaluable learning experiences, facing philosophical questions, and contributing to designing a world that is both exhilarating and human.
This web site is primarily about my books. Check out also my academic profile available at kauppinen.net/tomi.
title: About Tomi Kauppinen

body:
HUMAN In this world full of open questions and uncertainty HUMAN is the story of people engaging to cope with what they perceive and experience. This future world is easy, yet strange to live in as a human. Queen with its AI-powered, mysterious operations is providing people virtually everything. The role of a human being is to enjoy. New controlling orders, regular bright light sessions and queen bots raise suspicions. However, we can evidence those who are human. Queen wants to make clear there is a difference between them and human. What will people do? Will they learn something about themselves, the world and Queen? The stakes are high in this adventure about what we can call human. HUMAN is a timely book in this era of Artificial Intelligence. HUMAN seeks to be a timeless story touching both our generations and the future generations to come.
— HUMAN by Tomi Kauppinen
